title: Detroit: Become Human
notes: Played a few minutes in the second mission (Bellini paints), the game is playable, with a few stutters here and there. I used the hex editor patch for the terrible blur. Then I had to disable HDR in the GraphicOptions.JSON, because the image was overexposed.
issues: On every launch I have to delete VkPipelineCache.bin or it won't launch. Terrible blur in the foreground.
